description.zh:
功能开关，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the `Alt-Svc` header. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables the Alt-Svc header.

- `off`: Disables the Alt-Svc header.

description.zh:
Alt-Svc头是否包含clear参数，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include the `clear` directive in the `Alt-Svc` header. The directive is not included by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Includes the directive.

- `off`: Does not include the directive.

description.zh: Alt-Svc有效时间，单位是秒，默认为86400秒。
description.en: The max-age for the Alt-Svc header, in seconds. The default is 86400.

description.zh:
Alt-Svc头包是否含persist参数，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include the `persist` directive in the `Alt-Svc` header. The directive is not included by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Includes the directive.

- `off`: Does not include the directive.

description.zh:
是否开启HSTS，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS). This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables HSTS.

- `off`: Disables HSTS.

description.zh:
是否在HSTS中包括子域，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include subdomains in the HSTS policy. Subdomains are not included by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Includes subdomains.

- `off`: Does not include subdomains.

description.zh:
是否开启HSTS预加载，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable HSTS Preload. HSTS Preload is disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables Preload.

- `off`: Disables Preload.

description.zh:
是否开启强制HTTPS，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Force HTTPS. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables Force HTTPS.

- `off`: Disables Force HTTPS.

description.zh:
强制HTTPS跳转状态码，取值范围：
- 301
- 302
- 307
- 308
description.en:
The redirect status code for Force HTTPS. Valid values:

- `301`

- `302`

- `307`

- `308`

description.zh:
是否开启拒绝无SNI的TLS握手请求，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to deny TLS handshake requests that do not include an SNI. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Denies requests without an SNI.

- `off`: Allows requests without an SNI.

description.zh:
是否开启SNI校验，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Server Name Indication (SNI) verification. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables SNI verification.

- `off`: Disables SNI verification.

description.zh: 指定允许的SNI白名单列表，多个以空格分隔。
description.en: The SNI allowlist. Separate multiple hostnames with spaces.

description.zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
description.en:
The conditional expression that the rule uses to match requests. This parameter is not required for a global configuration.

- To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

- To match specific requests, provide a custom expression, such as `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`

description.zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required for a global configuration. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables the rule.

- `off`: Disables the rule.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The rule name. This parameter is not required for a global configuration.

description.zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行。
description.en: The execution order of the rule. A lower value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. To obtain this ID, call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-https-application-configuration --site-id 1234560000 --config-id 352816096980000 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --https-force on --https-force-code 301 --alt-svc on --alt-svc-clear on --alt-svc-persist on --alt-svc-ma 86400 --hsts on --hsts-max-age 3600 --hsts-include-subdomains on --hsts-preload on --sequence 1 --https-sni-verify on --https-no-sni-deny on --https-sni-whitelist abc_edf --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateHttpsApplicationConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --HstsIncludeSubdomains on --AltSvcMa 86400 --RuleEnable on --HttpsForceCode 301 --AltSvc on --HttpsNoSniDeny on --Hsts on --HstsPreload on --HstsMaxAge 3600 --Sequence 1 --HttpsSniWhitelist abc_edf --AltSvcPersist on --HttpsSniVerify on --AltSvcClear on --HttpsForce on --ConfigId 352816096980000 --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --RuleName rule_example
